caption_en: Wheelchair and handcycle athletes on the road
caption_es: Atletas en silla de ruedas y handbike en la carretera
alt_en: A wheelchair racer and a handcycle athlete roll down a two-lane road while a photographer shoots from the roadside.
A big field of runners in race bibs sets off on a sunny morning under a wide sky.

caption_es: Vistas de montaña desde el sendero
alt_en: Runners on a winding paved trail through high-desert brush with blue mountains behind.
A long line of runners and walkers follows a curving paved trail past new plantings and stone.

caption_es: Puesto de agua cerca de la milla 12
alt_en: A runner leaves a volunteer water table beside a mile 12 marker on the trail.
Two runners side by side on the trail next to a mile 12 sign.
A smiling runner crosses a small bridge with red railings, other runners behind her.

caption_en: Drummers cheer runners on the course
caption_es: Tamborileros animan a los corredores en el recorrido
alt_en: Two drummers play hand drums on the grass beside the trail as a runner passes.

caption_en: Drummers cheer runners on the course
caption_es: Tamborileros animan a los corredores en el recorrido
alt_en: Two drummers play beside the trail as two runners go by smiling.
Two young volunteers hand a cup of water to a runner at a trailside water table.

caption_en: Along the trail through the park
caption_es: Por el sendero junto al parque
alt_en: Runners on a paved path beside a park and a chain-link fence, a spectator watching.
Runners on a railed paved path through green trees, mountains in the distance.

caption_en: Past an El Camino Real trail sign
caption_es: Junto a una señal de El Camino Real
alt_en: Runners on a paved path through trees, passing a sign that reads El Camino Real.
A runner in a rainbow hat gives two thumbs up on a paved trail, another runner beside him and mountains behind.

caption_en: Chamisa in bloom along the trail
caption_es: Chamisa en flor junto al sendero
alt_en: A smiling runner on a paved path between yellow-flowering chamisa bushes, a bridge behind her.
A runner crosses tall grass under a wide blue sky with clouds and mountains on the horizon.
A runner in a pink shirt comes over a grassy rise with blue mountains and white clouds behind.
Two runners side by side through tall grass with mountains and clouds behind them.

caption_es: Entre la hierba del desierto alto
alt_en: A runner in a white cap moves through tall golden grass with mountains in the distance.
A smiling runner in a pink cap crosses a grassy rise with mountains and big white clouds behind.
A runner in a green tank top heads down a paved trail toward blue mountains under a big sky, others ahead of him.
A runner in a purple shirt comes up a paved path between metal railings, long shadows across the concrete.
Two runners pass each other on a railed paved path with long shadows, trees on the left.
A runner in a race shirt on a winding tree-lined path, a large mountain behind and other runners ahead.
A runner on a paved path under bright sun, trees and a stream channel beside her, mountains far off.

caption_en: Capitol Ford tent at the Reunity Resources farm stand
caption_es: La carpa de Capitol Ford en el puesto de Reunity Resources
alt_en: People gather under a blue Capitol Ford tent in front of a red barn at the finish area.
A woman in a light blue jacket speaks into a microphone at the finish area.
A runner wearing a medal throws his arms up in celebration while another holds result sheets.
